_comment: ACTIVE as of 2026-07-29 (owner direction): pre-animated short clips for long-form backgrounds, replacing the static-image + Agent-3.2-adds-motion workflow and the (now scrapped) rain overlay. Owner supplied 20 short AI-generated clips (already have their own subtle looping motion baked in — ripples, drifting mist, pulsing lights, swaying trees, falling snow, etc.) in Drive folder 1ZXfCyRnuWrTMYKKYeAjDCMSvhGOTa3G6. Agent 2.2 pulls an unused entry from here instead of generating/sourcing a static image; Agent 3.2's job becomes building the ping-pong (forward + reversed, with a speed ramp at the cut) seamless loop from the clip, not adding motion to a static image. See agents/long_form/3.2_animator.md's 'Ping-pong loop with speed ramp' section for the exact ffmpeg recipe. source='owner_ai_generated_clip' for image_copyright_gate purposes — same provenance category discipline as owner_ai_generated_from_reference (state/image_pool.json): owner's own account is these were generated by an AI video tool from prompts, not filmed/downloaded footage, but still needs the same per-file visual check (watermarks, off-theme content, anything unexpectedly explicit/real) before use. The legacy static-image folders (both the very old owner_provided_unverified one and the newer owner_ai_generated_from_reference one in state/image_pool.json) are superseded by this pool for new candidates going forward, per the same 'never fall back to an old source, ask the owner instead' rule already in place for the legacy image folder.
catalog_note: 19 of the folder's 20 clips are catalogued below (cheap to re-list the folder directly to confirm the exact count/find the 20th before assuming this list is exhaustive).

unused_pool.description: Static tripod shot of luxury garage at dusk with two supercars parked inside. Warm summer breeze continuously moves trees/bushes outside the garage, soft shadows shifting.
Static shot, two black supercars on cobblestone driveway at night. Gentle tropical breeze sways palm leaves/hanging vines continuously; Lamborghini scissor door slowly opens.
Static shot. Thick night mist slowly drifts across a parking lot left to right. Tree branches/palm leaves sway gently in a light breeze.
Static shot of supercars on a modern driveway at night, city skyline behind. Distant city lights shimmering/twinkling, car headlights soft glow.
Locked shot, sunset ocean scene with five luxury vehicles in front of palm trees. Only the palm fronds sway; sunset/ocean/vehicles static.
Locked shot. Gentle heat haze and thin white exhaust vapor drifting from a supercar's exhaust. Soft ambient city-light glow pulsating.
Locked shot. Fairy string lights hanging from a glass atrium ceiling gently pulse with warm glow; an LED light inside a car trunk has a faint slow breathing glow.
Locked shot, cinemagraph. Deep pink underglow beneath a white Rolls-Royce and orange Lamborghini Aventador slowly pulsating.
Locked shot, black Koenigsegg supercar at night in Dubai. Pulsating glow on red taillights and on 'DUBAI MALL' sign lights in the background; faint heat haze.
Locked shot, purple Porsche GT3 parked at a harbor with a yacht and mountains at golden hour. Rear light bar/taillights slowly, subtly pulse.
Fixed camera, night scene with a silver car (open trunk), person loading items, modern glass building behind. Subtle flickering warm light reflections.
Static shot, night scene with multiple sports cars — all have bright red LED taillights dynamically pulsing/flashing with lens flares; visible smoke/haze.

consumed.description: Locked camera, morning countryside scene. Gentle fog drifts slowly across a field left to right. Large tree with leaves moving.
Static tripod shot. Soft, gentle snowflakes fall through night air against a snowy scene with a white sports car in a driveway; warm garage-light glow.
Static tripod shot of luxury marina at night with yachts and skyscrapers. Marina water continuously ripples, bright moving reflections beneath yachts and illuminated towers.
consumed.provenance_note: Real 'EMAAR' and other legible real-estate/brand signage visible on the marina towers in the background (Dubai Marina skyline) -- same disclosed pattern as the legacy image folder's Dubai skyline shots (see agents/long_form/2.2_image_sourcer.md Path B note). Owner-supplied AI-generated clip (source=owner_ai_generated_clip, Path C), not a scraped photo/video, but the signage itself reads as real -- flagged here per the per-file visual-check discipline, no action needed unless a claim lands (see config/gates.json image_copyright_gate backstop).

consumed.description: Static shot, luxury mansion at colorful sunset. Gentle breeze sways palm fronds, slow wispy clouds drift, warm mansion interior lights flicker.
